protocol: research_v3 cb_rotation: China convertible-bond double-low rotation for a 20,000-30,000 CNY account

data.list: Eastmoney RPT_BOND_CB_LIST (all bonds incl. delisted; listing date, delisting date, redemption notice dates, redemption price)
data.bars: Sina bond_zh_hs_cov_daily (OHLC, volume) + Tencent (amount); last trading day = last bar
data.valuation: Eastmoney RPTA_WEB_KZZ_LS daily series (conversion value, premium, conversion price); truncated at the last bar; where conversion price is missing, implied from conversion value and the underlying close (research_v3/stock_mf local data)
data.events: redemption notice date (NOTICE_DATE_SH/HS); downward revisions as embedded in the daily conversion-price series
data.benchmarks: CSI Convertible Bond Index (000832) price index; CSI300 (510300 total return from research_v3 data); EW_CB built from the universe

universe.schedule: evaluated at each weekly signal (last session of the week)
eligible_if_all: has a bar with volume > 0 on the signal date
20-session mean daily amount >= 5,000,000 CNY (replaces outstanding-size filter, unavailable for SSE bonds)
no forced-redemption notice published on or before the signal date
last trading day not known to be within the next 20 sessions (maturity)
underlying stock not inferred-ST on the signal date (research_v3/stock_mf inferred-ST rule)

signal.score: double-low = close price + 100 x conversion premium rate (premium as a decimal), using values dated on or before the signal close
signal.selection: hold the 10 lowest scores; an existing holding is kept while its score rank is <= 20 and it stays eligible; remaining slots filled by the lowest-ranked non-held bonds
signal.weights: equal weight 1/10 for new buys; kept holdings are not resized
signal.forced_exit: a holding that becomes ineligible (e.g. redemption notice, inferred-ST underlying) is sold at the next session open even between rebalances
signal.rebalance: weekly; trades at the next session open

execution_model.t_plus_0: allowed but not used (orders only at opens)
execution_model.price_limits: no daily limit before 2022-08-01; from 2022-08-01 +/-20% (effective date unverified, declared); a buy is blocked if open >= +20% limit, a sell if open <= -20% limit; blocked orders retry each open

delisting.redemption_or_maturity: if still held at the last bar, converted to cash at the last close
delisting.passive_delisting: a bond whose delisting is not explained by a redemption notice or maturity (default, underlying delisting, unknown code) is converted at 0% of its last close on its last trading day (decision version); sensitivity: 50%

costs.commission: 1 bp per side, minimum 1 CNY per order (decision version); sensitivity: minimum 5 CNY

accounts.SMALL: 25,000 CNY, 10-bond lots, leftover cash earns SHIBOR (decision version)

periods.holdout: 2024-01-01 to 2026-09-30; guarded (authorisation file + one-time state file), run only after the user's go-ahead in chat

benchmarks.EW_CB: equal weight across all eligible bonds, weekly, same costs, LARGE account
benchmarks.CB_INDEX: CSI Convertible Bond Index price index buy and hold

metrics: stationary block bootstrap (block 21, 2000 resamples, seed 20261019) 90% CI of excess Sharpe difference vs EW_CB and vs CB_INDEX

decision_on_development.version: SMALL, commission 1 bp min 1 CNY, slippage 10 bp, passive delisting at 0%
PASS_if_all: DEV excess Sharpe > EW_CB and > CB_INDEX
excess Sharpe > EW_CB in DEV_A and in DEV_B
first condition still holds with 30 bp slippage and with min 5 CNY commission
decision_on_development.if_PASS: ask the user for the one-time holdout run

declared_biases: no SSE outstanding-size history (amount filter used instead)
no delisting-period prices for passive delistings (0% terminal assumption)
benchmark CB index is a price index
freeze_rule: Frozen once hashed; changes only via labelled amendments written before the affected run.
